findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the handwashing sink to be obstructed by a sanitizer bucket. Discussed with PIC, and bucket was removed from the sink to allow for easy hand washing. Ensure that hand sinks are not obstructed during service.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the sanitizer bucket in the kitchen to have too much bleach in it. It was bleaching out the strips. Inspector dumped sanitizer bucket and mixed a new bucket at 50PPM of chlorine sanitizer. Ensure sanitizer is made at the correct concentration. Facility has test strips.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A).

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
PIC present at time of inspection is not CFPM certified.  A CFPM must be on-site during hours of operation.  Ensure kitchen employees and future employees obtain certification.

2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
Facility uses a spray bottle for sanitizer and cloth towel.  Discussed with PIC, use a paper towel or a new cloth each time to sanitizer surfaces and discard.  Using a cloth towel with a spray bottle spreads contaminants acquired in between uses.  Ensure a paper towel or a new cloth is used with sanitizing surfaces.

3-304.14: (A) Cloths in-use for wiping FOOD spills for TABLEWARE and carryout containers shall be dry and used for no other purpose. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. (C) Cloths in-use for wiping raw animal FOOD surfaces shall be separate from other cloths. (D) Dry wiping cloths and sanitizing solution shall be free of FOOD debris and other soil. (E) Containers of sanitizing solution shall be stored off floor and used in manner to prevent contamination. (F) SINGLE-USE disposable sanitizer wipes shall be used in accordance with EPA labels.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Test strips present in kitchen are expired and not accurately working.  Discussed with PIC on how to read the test strips present until new ones are obtained.  Ensure test strips are always available and not expired.

4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Inspector observed dish washing procedures in kitchen.  Kitchen is equipped with a 2-part sink and a dish machine.  Employee states dishes are hand washed and rinsed by hand.  Dish machine is only allowed to run 1x/day, so half the dishes are ran in the dish machine after hand washing and rinsing, therefore receiving sanitation step.  The dishes unable to fit in the dish machine are hand washed, rinsed, dried, and put away.  No sanitation step is applied to these dishes.  Sanitation is required of all food contract surfaces to prevent contamination of food.  Inspector discussed process with PIC, who will correct this procedure.  Ensure all food contact surfaces are sanitized.

4-703.11: After cleaning, FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be SANITIZED in: (A) manual hot water operations. (B) mechanical hot water operations. (C) Chemical manual or mechanical operations. Contact times shall be consistent with those on EPA-registered label use  standard contact time 30 seconds.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
Soiled cloth aprons were observed being stored on shelving holding clean equipment.  Soiled linens may not come in contact with food contact surfaces.  Employee removed aprons on site.  Ensure aprons are stored in a separate location from food contact surfaces to prevent contamination.

4-903.11: (A) clean FOOD-CONTACT surfaces shall be stored: in clean, dry location, not exposed to splash or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above floor. (B) clean EQUIPMENT shall be stored in self-draining position that allows air drying, covered or inverted. (D) Items that are kept in closed PACKAGES may be stored below 6 inches if on dollies, pallets, racks, and skids properly designed.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
A temperature measuring device for the dish machine is not available at facility.  A temperature measuring device shall be readily available to ensure acceptable sanitation temperature is achieved by the dish machine.  Ensure a temperature measuring device is provided and readily accessible.

4-302.13: (A) In manual WAREWASHING operations, a TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be provided and readily accessible for frequently measuring the washing and SANITIZING temperatures. (B) In hot water mechanical WAREWASHING operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the UTENSIL surface temperature.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. 
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels

Hand sink obstructed by plastic bag upon arrival and lacked paper towels. Discussed handwashing with PIC. Ensure it is stocked and available at all times for proper handwashing practices. COS
